calls.statement:
SELECT o.status,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_distinct,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=l.product_key WHERE l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test')) AS n_test,
       MIN(o.order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01') AS utc_date_count_for_comparison
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
